# Employee Leave Policy (HR-001)

> SYNTHETIC SAMPLE POLICY. Brightlake Systems is a fictional company. This document was created for a training exercise and does not describe any real organisation.

## 1. Purpose and Scope

This policy explains the types of leave available to permanent full-time employees of Brightlake Systems and how leave is requested and approved. Part-time employees receive leave on a pro-rata basis. Contractors are not covered by this policy.

## 2. Annual Leave

Full-time employees receive 20 days of paid annual leave per calendar year. Annual leave accrues at 1.67 days per completed month of service.

chunks.section: 2. Annual Leave; 3. Carry-Forward of Annual Leave
chunks.text:
Annual leave accrues at 1.67 days per completed month of service.

Employees must submit annual leave requests through the HR Portal at least 7 calendar days before the first day of leave. Requests for 5 or more consecutive working days must be submitted at least 21 calendar days in advance. All annual leave requires approval from the employee's line manager.

## 3. Carry-Forward of Annual Leave

A maximum of 5 unused annual leave days may be carried forward into the next calendar year. Carried-forward days must be used by 31 March of the following year; any carried-forward days not used by that date expire. Unused annual leave cannot be exchanged for cash, except as part of final settlement when an employee leaves the company.

chunks.section: 4. Sick Leave; 5. Parental Leave
chunks.text:
Unused annual leave cannot be exchanged for cash, except as part of final settlement when an employee leaves the company.

## 4. Sick Leave

Employees receive 10 days of paid sick leave per calendar year. Sick leave does not carry forward. Employees must notify their line manager before 10:00 on the first day of absence. A medical certificate from a registered doctor is required for any sick absence longer than 2 consecutive working days.

## 5. Parental Leave

Birth mothers are entitled to 26 weeks of paid maternity leave. Employees must have completed at least 80 days of service in the 12 months before the expected delivery date to be eligible.

chunks.section: 5. Parental Leave; 6. Bereavement Leave; 7. Public Holidays
chunks.text:
Employees must have completed at least 80 days of service in the 12 months before the expected delivery date to be eligible.

Fathers and secondary caregivers are entitled to 10 working days of paid paternity leave, which must be taken within 3 months of the child's birth.

## 6. Bereavement Leave

Employees may take up to 5 working days of paid bereavement leave following the death of an immediate family member (spouse or partner, child, parent, sibling, or grandparent).

## 7. Public Holidays

Brightlake Systems publishes a list of 12 public holidays each December for the following calendar year. Employees required to work on a public holiday receive one compensatory day off, which must be taken within 60 days.

chunks.section: 8. Contact
chunks.text:
Employees required to work on a public holiday receive one compensatory day off, which must be taken within 60 days.

## 8. Contact

Questions about this policy should be directed to the HR Operations team at hr-ops@brightlake.example.

# Work-From-Home Policy (HR-002)

> SYNTHETIC SAMPLE POLICY. Brightlake Systems is a fictional company. This document was created for a training exercise and does not describe any real organisation.

## 1. Purpose and Scope

This policy sets out when and how employees of Brightlake Systems may work from home. It applies to all permanent employees whose role has been designated "hybrid-eligible" by their department head.

## 2. Eligibility

Employees become eligible to work from home after successfully completing their probation period. Employees still on probation must work from the office unless their department head grants a written exception.

chunks.section: 3. Number of Work-From-Home Days; 4. Requesting Work-From-Home Days
chunks.text:
Employees still on probation must work from the office unless their department head grants a written exception.

## 3. Number of Work-From-Home Days

Eligible employees may work from home for up to 2 days per week. Work-from-home days cannot be accumulated or carried over to a later week.

## 4. Requesting Work-From-Home Days

Work-from-home days must be requested in the HR Portal by 17:00 on the Friday of the preceding week. The line manager approves or declines each request. Managers may decline requests during critical project phases, client visits, or mandatory in-office events.

chunks.section: 5. Core Working Hours; 6. Home Workspace and Security
chunks.text:
Managers may decline requests during critical project phases, client visits, or mandatory in-office events.

## 5. Core Working Hours

Employees working from home must be available online between the core hours of 10:00 and 16:00 local time. During core hours employees must respond to messages within 30 minutes and keep their calendar status up to date.

## 6. Home Workspace and Security

Employees must work from a quiet, private space where confidential information cannot be seen or overheard. Employees must connect to company systems through the company VPN at all times when working from home. Use of public Wi-Fi networks for work is permitted only when connected through the company VPN.

chunks.section: 7. Internet Allowance; 8. Working From Another Country; 9. Contact
chunks.text:
Use of public Wi-Fi networks for work is permitted only when connected through the company VPN.

## 7. Internet Allowance

Hybrid-eligible employees receive a monthly internet allowance of USD 40, paid automatically through payroll. No receipts are required for the internet allowance.

## 8. Working From Another Country

Working remotely from a country other than the employee's country of employment requires prior written approval from HR and is limited to a maximum of 30 calendar days per calendar year.

## 9. Contact

Questions about this policy should be directed to the HR Operations team at hr-ops@brightlake.example.

# Employee Reimbursement Policy (HR-003)

> SYNTHETIC SAMPLE POLICY. Brightlake Systems is a fictional company. This document was created for a training exercise and does not describe any real organisation.

## 1. Purpose and Scope

This policy explains which business expenses Brightlake Systems reimburses and how employees submit expense claims. It applies to all permanent employees and interns.

## 2. Submitting a Claim

Expense claims must be submitted through the Expense Portal within 30 calendar days of the date the expense was incurred. Claims submitted after 30 days will be rejected unless the Finance Controller approves a late submission.

chunks.section: 2. Submitting a Claim; 3. Approval and Payment; 4. Business Travel - Flights and Accommodation
chunks.text:
Claims submitted after 30 days will be rejected unless the Finance Controller approves a late submission.

An itemised receipt is required for every individual expense above USD 25. Expenses of USD 25 or less may be claimed without a receipt, provided a description of the expense is entered.

## 3. Approval and Payment

All expense claims must be approved by the employee's line manager. Claims above USD 1,000 also require approval from the department head. Approved claims are paid with the next monthly payroll cycle.

## 4. Business Travel - Flights and Accommodation

Flights must be booked in economy class for journeys under 6 hours. Premium economy may be booked for journeys of 6 hours or longer. Hotel accommodation is reimbursed up to USD 180 per night.

chunks.section: 5. Business Travel - Meals; 6. Use of a Personal Vehicle; 7. Non-Reimbursable Expenses
chunks.text:
Premium economy may be booked for journeys of 6 hours or longer. Hotel accommodation is reimbursed up to USD 180 per night.

## 5. Business Travel - Meals

Meals during business travel are reimbursed up to USD 60 per day. Alcoholic beverages are not reimbursable under any circumstances.

## 6. Use of a Personal Vehicle

Employees who use their personal vehicle for approved business travel are reimbursed at USD 0.40 per kilometre. Fuel receipts are not required for mileage claims, but the start point, destination and distance must be recorded in the claim.

## 7. Non-Reimbursable Expenses

The following are not reimbursable: alcoholic beverages, traffic or parking fines, personal entertainment, in-flight purchases, and expenses for family members accompanying the employee.

# Employee Onboarding Policy (HR-004)

> SYNTHETIC SAMPLE POLICY. Brightlake Systems is a fictional company. This document was created for a training exercise and does not describe any real organisation.

## 1. Purpose and Scope

This policy describes the onboarding process for new permanent employees joining Brightlake Systems, from before their first day until the end of their probation period.

## 2. Before the First Day

New employees must submit the following documents through the HR Portal before their joining date: a government-issued photo ID, bank account details for payroll, and the signed offer letter. HR sends a welcome email with first-day instructions 5 working days before the joining date.

chunks.section: 3. First Day; 4. Onboarding Buddy; 5. Mandatory Training
chunks.text:
HR sends a welcome email with first-day instructions 5 working days before the joining date.

## 3. First Day

New employees attend an orientation session that starts at 09:30 on their first day. During orientation they receive their company laptop, ID badge, and system accounts.

## 4. Onboarding Buddy

Every new employee is assigned an onboarding buddy from their team. The buddy supports the new employee for their first 90 days.

## 5. Mandatory Training

New employees must complete two mandatory training courses within 14 calendar days of joining: Security Awareness Training and Code of Conduct Training. Both courses are completed through the Learning Portal.

chunks.section: 6. Probation Period; 7. Contact
chunks.text:
Both courses are completed through the Learning Portal.

## 6. Probation Period

The probation period for new employees is 6 months. Line managers hold structured check-in meetings with new employees at 30, 60, and 90 days after joining. Confirmation of employment is communicated in writing at the end of the probation period.

## 7. Contact

Questions about this policy should be directed to the HR Operations team at hr-ops@brightlake.example.

# Password and Account Security Policy (IT-001)

> SYNTHETIC SAMPLE POLICY. Brightlake Systems is a fictional company. This document was created for a training exercise and does not describe any real organisation.

## 1. Purpose and Scope

This policy defines the minimum requirements for passwords and account security for every Brightlake Systems user account, including employees, interns and contractors.

## 2. Password Requirements

Passwords must be at least 14 characters long. Passwords must not contain the user's name, username, or the word "Brightlake". Users must not reuse any of their previous 10 passwords.

Passwords must be changed every 180 days, and immediately if there is any suspicion that a password has been compromised.

chunks.section: 3. Multi-Factor Authentication; 4. Account Lockout
chunks.text:
Passwords must be changed every 180 days, and immediately if there is any suspicion that a password has been compromised.

## 3. Multi-Factor Authentication

Multi-factor authentication (MFA) is mandatory for all accounts. Users must use the Brightlake Authenticator mobile app as their second factor. SMS codes are not an approved MFA method.

## 4. Account Lockout

An account is automatically locked for 15 minutes after 5 consecutive failed sign-in attempts. If the account is locked again within 24 hours, it remains locked until it is unlocked by the IT Service Desk.

chunks.section: 5. Password Storage and Sharing; 6. Reporting a Compromised Account; 7. Enforcement
chunks.text:
If the account is locked again within 24 hours, it remains locked until it is unlocked by the IT Service Desk.

## 5. Password Storage and Sharing

Passwords must never be shared with anyone, including colleagues, managers, or IT staff. Passwords must not be written down or stored in plain-text files. The only approved password manager is KeyVault, which is installed on all company laptops.

## 6. Reporting a Compromised Account

If a user suspects that their password or account has been compromised, they must report it to the IT Service Desk within 1 hour of noticing the issue. The IT Service Desk can be reached on internal extension 4357 or at servicedesk@brightlake.example.

## 7. Enforcement

Violations of this policy may result in suspension of system access and disciplinary action.

# IT Equipment Usage Policy (IT-002)

> SYNTHETIC SAMPLE POLICY. Brightlake Systems is a fictional company. This document was created for a training exercise and does not describe any real organisation.

## 1. Purpose and Scope

This policy explains how company-issued IT equipment, such as laptops, monitors, headsets and mobile phones, must be used, protected, and returned.

## 2. Issued Equipment

Every employee is issued a company laptop on or before their first working day. Laptops are replaced on a standard refresh cycle of every 4 years, or earlier if the device is faulty and cannot be repaired.

All company laptops use full-disk encryption, which must never be disabled.

chunks.section: 3. Acceptable Use; 4. Software Installation; 5. Removable Storage
chunks.text:
All company laptops use full-disk encryption, which must never be disabled.

## 3. Acceptable Use

Company equipment is provided for business use. Limited personal use, such as reading personal email during breaks, is permitted provided it does not interfere with work or breach any company policy.

## 4. Software Installation

Employees may install software only from the Brightlake Software Centre. Installing any other software requires prior approval from IT through a request raised in TechDesk, the IT ticketing system.

## 5. Removable Storage

USB storage devices are blocked on company laptops by default. Only encrypted USB drives issued by the IT department may be used.

chunks.section: 6. Lost or Stolen Equipment; 7. Returning Equipment; 8. Contact
chunks.text:
USB storage devices are blocked on company laptops by default. Only encrypted USB drives issued by the IT department may be used.

## 6. Lost or Stolen Equipment

Lost or stolen equipment must be reported to the IT Service Desk within 24 hours of discovering the loss. If a device is stolen, the employee must also file a police report and attach the report reference to the TechDesk ticket.

## 7. Returning Equipment

When an employee leaves Brightlake Systems, all company equipment must be returned within 5 working days of the last working day. The cost of unreturned equipment may be deducted from the employee's final settlement.

## 8. Contact

Questions about this policy should be directed to the IT Service Desk on internal extension 4357.

# Work-From-Home Policy (HR-002)

> SYNTHETIC SAMPLE POLICY. Brightlake Systems is a fictional company. This document was created for a training exercise and does not describe any real organisation.

## 1. Purpose and Scope

This policy sets out when and how employees of Brightlake Systems may work from home. It applies to all permanent employees whose role has been designated "hybrid-eligible" by their department head.

## 2. Eligibility

Employees become eligible to work from home after successfully completing their probation period. Employees still on probation must work from the office unless their department head grants a written exception.

## 3. Number of Work-From-Home Days

chunks.section: 3. Number of Work-From-Home Days; 4. Requesting Work-From-Home Days; 5. Core Working Hours; 6. Home Workspace and Security
chunks.text:
## 3. Number of Work-From-Home Days

Eligible employees may work from home for up to 2 days per week. Work-from-home days cannot be accumulated or carried over to a later week.

## 4. Requesting Work-From-Home Days

Work-from-home days must be requested in the HR Portal by 17:00 on the Friday of the preceding week. The line manager approves or declines each request. Managers may decline requests during critical project phases, client visits, or mandatory in-office events.

## 5. Core Working Hours

Employees working from home must be available online between the core hours of 10:00 and 16:00 local time. During core hours employees must respond to messages within 30 minutes and keep their calendar status up to date.

## 6. Home Workspace and Security

chunks.section: 6. Home Workspace and Security; 7. Internet Allowance; 8. Working From Another Country; 9. Contact
chunks.text:
## 6. Home Workspace and Security

Employees must work from a quiet, private space where confidential information cannot be seen or overheard. Employees must connect to company systems through the company VPN at all times when working from home. Use of public Wi-Fi networks for work is permitted only when connected through the company VPN.

## 7. Internet Allowance

Hybrid-eligible employees receive a monthly internet allowance of USD 40, paid automatically through payroll. No receipts are required for the internet allowance.

## 8. Working From Another Country

Working remotely from a country other than the employee's country of employment requires prior written approval from HR and is limited to a maximum of 30 calendar days per calendar year.

## 9. Contact

chunks.section: 9. Contact
chunks.text:
## 9. Contact

Questions about this policy should be directed to the HR Operations team at hr-ops@brightlake.example.

# Employee Reimbursement Policy (HR-003)

> SYNTHETIC SAMPLE POLICY. Brightlake Systems is a fictional company. This document was created for a training exercise and does not describe any real organisation.

## 1. Purpose and Scope

This policy explains which business expenses Brightlake Systems reimburses and how employees submit expense claims. It applies to all permanent employees and interns.

## 2. Submitting a Claim

Expense claims must be submitted through the Expense Portal within 30 calendar days of the date the expense was incurred. Claims submitted after 30 days will be rejected unless the Finance Controller approves a late submission.

chunks.section: 2. Submitting a Claim; 3. Approval and Payment; 4. Business Travel - Flights and Accommodation; 5. Business Travel - Meals
chunks.text:
An itemised receipt is required for every individual expense above USD 25. Expenses of USD 25 or less may be claimed without a receipt, provided a description of the expense is entered.

## 3. Approval and Payment

All expense claims must be approved by the employee's line manager. Claims above USD 1,000 also require approval from the department head. Approved claims are paid with the next monthly payroll cycle.

## 4. Business Travel - Flights and Accommodation

Flights must be booked in economy class for journeys under 6 hours. Premium economy may be booked for journeys of 6 hours or longer. Hotel accommodation is reimbursed up to USD 180 per night.

## 5. Business Travel - Meals

chunks.section: 5. Business Travel - Meals; 6. Use of a Personal Vehicle; 7. Non-Reimbursable Expenses; 8. Contact
chunks.text:
## 5. Business Travel - Meals

Meals during business travel are reimbursed up to USD 60 per day. Alcoholic beverages are not reimbursable under any circumstances.

## 6. Use of a Personal Vehicle

Employees who use their personal vehicle for approved business travel are reimbursed at USD 0.40 per kilometre. Fuel receipts are not required for mileage claims, but the start point, destination and distance must be recorded in the claim.

## 7. Non-Reimbursable Expenses

The following are not reimbursable: alcoholic beverages, traffic or parking fines, personal entertainment, in-flight purchases, and expenses for family members accompanying the employee.

## 8. Contact

Questions about this policy should be directed to the Finance team at expenses@brightlake.example.

chunks.text:
# Employee Onboarding Policy (HR-004)

> SYNTHETIC SAMPLE POLICY. Brightlake Systems is a fictional company. This document was created for a training exercise and does not describe any real organisation.

## 1. Purpose and Scope

This policy describes the onboarding process for new permanent employees joining Brightlake Systems, from before their first day until the end of their probation period.

## 2. Before the First Day

New employees must submit the following documents through the HR Portal before their joining date: a government-issued photo ID, bank account details for payroll, and the signed offer letter. HR sends a welcome email with first-day instructions 5 working days before the joining date.

## 3. First Day

chunks.section: 3. First Day; 4. Onboarding Buddy; 5. Mandatory Training; 6. Probation Period
chunks.text:
## 3. First Day

New employees attend an orientation session that starts at 09:30 on their first day. During orientation they receive their company laptop, ID badge, and system accounts.

## 4. Onboarding Buddy

Every new employee is assigned an onboarding buddy from their team. The buddy supports the new employee for their first 90 days.

## 5. Mandatory Training

New employees must complete two mandatory training courses within 14 calendar days of joining: Security Awareness Training and Code of Conduct Training. Both courses are completed through the Learning Portal.

## 6. Probation Period

chunks.section: 6. Probation Period; 7. Contact
chunks.text:
## 6. Probation Period

The probation period for new employees is 6 months. Line managers hold structured check-in meetings with new employees at 30, 60, and 90 days after joining. Confirmation of employment is communicated in writing at the end of the probation period.

## 7. Contact

Questions about this policy should be directed to the HR Operations team at hr-ops@brightlake.example.

chunks.text:
# Password and Account Security Policy (IT-001)

> SYNTHETIC SAMPLE POLICY. Brightlake Systems is a fictional company. This document was created for a training exercise and does not describe any real organisation.

## 1. Purpose and Scope

This policy defines the minimum requirements for passwords and account security for every Brightlake Systems user account, including employees, interns and contractors.

## 2. Password Requirements

Passwords must be at least 14 characters long. Passwords must not contain the user's name, username, or the word "Brightlake". Users must not reuse any of their previous 10 passwords.

Passwords must be changed every 180 days, and immediately if there is any suspicion that a password has been compromised.

## 3. Multi-Factor Authentication

chunks.section: 3. Multi-Factor Authentication; 4. Account Lockout; 5. Password Storage and Sharing; 6. Reporting a Compromised Account
chunks.text:
## 3. Multi-Factor Authentication

Multi-factor authentication (MFA) is mandatory for all accounts. Users must use the Brightlake Authenticator mobile app as their second factor. SMS codes are not an approved MFA method.

## 4. Account Lockout

An account is automatically locked for 15 minutes after 5 consecutive failed sign-in attempts. If the account is locked again within 24 hours, it remains locked until it is unlocked by the IT Service Desk.

## 5. Password Storage and Sharing

Passwords must never be shared with anyone, including colleagues, managers, or IT staff. Passwords must not be written down or stored in plain-text files. The only approved password manager is KeyVault, which is installed on all company laptops.

## 6. Reporting a Compromised Account

chunks.section: 6. Reporting a Compromised Account; 7. Enforcement
chunks.text:
## 6. Reporting a Compromised Account

If a user suspects that their password or account has been compromised, they must report it to the IT Service Desk within 1 hour of noticing the issue. The IT Service Desk can be reached on internal extension 4357 or at servicedesk@brightlake.example.

## 7. Enforcement

Violations of this policy may result in suspension of system access and disciplinary action.

chunks.text:
# IT Equipment Usage Policy (IT-002)

> SYNTHETIC SAMPLE POLICY. Brightlake Systems is a fictional company. This document was created for a training exercise and does not describe any real organisation.

## 1. Purpose and Scope

This policy explains how company-issued IT equipment, such as laptops, monitors, headsets and mobile phones, must be used, protected, and returned.

## 2. Issued Equipment

Every employee is issued a company laptop on or before their first working day. Laptops are replaced on a standard refresh cycle of every 4 years, or earlier if the device is faulty and cannot be repaired.

All company laptops use full-disk encryption, which must never be disabled.

## 3. Acceptable Use

chunks.section: 2. Issued Equipment; 3. Acceptable Use; 4. Software Installation; 5. Removable Storage; 6. Lost or Stolen Equipment
chunks.text:
All company laptops use full-disk encryption, which must never be disabled.

## 3. Acceptable Use

Company equipment is provided for business use. Limited personal use, such as reading personal email during breaks, is permitted provided it does not interfere with work or breach any company policy.

## 4. Software Installation

Employees may install software only from the Brightlake Software Centre. Installing any other software requires prior approval from IT through a request raised in TechDesk, the IT ticketing system.

## 5. Removable Storage

USB storage devices are blocked on company laptops by default. Only encrypted USB drives issued by the IT department may be used.

## 6. Lost or Stolen Equipment

chunks.section: 6. Lost or Stolen Equipment; 7. Returning Equipment; 8. Contact
chunks.text:
## 6. Lost or Stolen Equipment

Lost or stolen equipment must be reported to the IT Service Desk within 24 hours of discovering the loss. If a device is stolen, the employee must also file a police report and attach the report reference to the TechDesk ticket.

## 7. Returning Equipment

When an employee leaves Brightlake Systems, all company equipment must be returned within 5 working days of the last working day. The cost of unreturned equipment may be deducted from the employee's final settlement.

## 8. Contact

Questions about this policy should be directed to the IT Service Desk on internal extension 4357.
